items.review_rationale: Read derivative as entire real-valued function assigned pointwise to differentiable f on an open interval, using punctured difference-quotient limits and domain restrictions.

references.phrase: differentiable at every point of I
references.context: For each x inside open interval I, finite difference-quotient limit exists.
Map assigning to every x the derivative limit lim_{h→0}(f(x+h)−f(x))/h for nonzero h with x+h∈I.

references.phrase: derivative function distinct from derivative at one point
references.disposition: The domain of f′ consists of every point in I and presupposes differentiability at each.

items.review_rationale: Read kernel of K-linear transformation as inverse image of zero vector in W, an additive subspace of source V rather than target W.

references.phrase: vector spaces V,W over common field

references.context: Additive identity of target vector space W.
Set of v∈V mapped to target zero vector under linear transformation T.

references.disposition: The preimage uses target zero but is a subset of source V.

items.review_rationale: Read kernel of R-linear map of left modules as preimage of additive zero element of target N, preserving noncommutative ring/module context.

references.context: Elements m∈M such that phi(m)=0_N, a submodule of M.

references.phrase: module kernel not restricted to fields
references.disposition: Domain ring need only be associative under this formulation, distinct from vector-space kernel context.

items.review_rationale: Read topological boundary of A in fixed ambient X as closure minus interior, tracking ambient-relative topology and operations.

references.context: Points of closure not belonging to interior of A, both calculated relative to same X.

references.disposition: The subscript X is significant; replacing ambient topology may change boundary.
